installed_binary_observation: Native creation calls zeCommandListIsImmediate, forwards the native unique_ptr to the in-order native constructor and command-list manager, and installs an ownership-conditional native destroy deleter. Offline disassembly only; no GPU calls.
native_handle_error_policy: Pre-import empty-list guard cleans validation failures. At make_queue entry ownership transfers; no manual destroy after that entry, because installed adapter may already have adopted it during exception unwind. Import failure aborts initialization with no fallback/retry; an early pre-adoption resource may persist until failing process exit. No runtime-safety proof is claimed.
